DrawingPrizes.title: Sanarwa mai ban sha'awa: zane na farko
DrawingPrizes.textOne: Mun yi farin ciki da sanar da cewa za mu riƙe ta farko dabi'ar wannan Satumba! Shirya don damar lashe kyaututtuka masu ban mamaki, ciki har da Cruises, hutu, har ma da motoci.
DrawingPrizes.textThree:
- ** kyaututtukan da za a tabbatar: ** yayin da muke shirin bayar da kyaututtuka masu ban mamaki irin daga Cruises, hutu, da motoci, da ba a tabbatar da cewa an tabbatar da cewa an tabbatar da cewa jerin kyautuka na ƙarshe ba a tabbatar.
- ** batun canzawa: ** Dukkanin cikakkun bayanai suna fuskantar canji, kuma zamu bayar da sabuntawa da zaran an tabbatar dasu.
DrawingPrizes.textFour:
Duk mambobin da suka sauke app ɗin sun cancanci zane. Koyon yadda ake ƙara damar ku ta hanyar shigar da shigarwar ta hanyar ayyukan masu zuwa:

- ** App Ayyukan: ** don kowace rana ku yi amfani da app ɗin, kun sami shigarwa 1.
- ** Karɓi gayyatar Sannu: ** Sami shigar 30.
- ** Takeauki son kai: ** Sami shigarwar 8.
- ** Karɓi wayar taɗi ta hanyar: ** Sami shigarwar 50.
DrawingPrizes.textFive:
- ** Ingancin kafaffun: ** shigarwar suna da inganci don zane ɗaya kuma kada ku mirgine kowane haɗuwa da waɗannan ayyuka sau 10 cikin kwanaki 30:

1. Ziyarci Hannu Hangout
2. Raba app
3. Ku halarci Hootsa
4. Createirƙiri Hootsa

** Rollover shigarwar: ** Idan kun kammala wannan hadawar sau 10 cikin kwanaki 30, abubuwanku zasu yi.

### Kasancewa Aiki da Inganta Karuwarka! Ci gaba da amfani da app kuma yana halartar waɗannan ayyukan don haɓaka shigarwar da ƙara rashin nasara!

Discimer:
* Kyaututtukan da aka ambata a sama suna da ƙayyadadden canji. Za a sanar da kyaututtukan karshe na ƙarshe. Shiga cikin zane yana ƙarƙashin dokokin hukuma, wanda za'a kawo daga baya. Babu sayan da ya kamata don shiga ko nasara. Void inda aka haramta. *

Embassadordetails.text: Shin kuna sha'awar gig mai ban mamaki? Kasance da jakadan ** kuma ka zama wani sashi na yawan motsi!
Embassadordetails.textone: Muna buƙatar taimakonku don sanya dubuntar ɗakunan kasuwanci masu sha'awar shiga cikin abin da ke cikin motsi da ke haifar da abubuwan tunawa - ba kawai ma'amaloli ba ne. A matsayinka na jakadan hello, za ku sami $ 50 ga kowane kasuwancin da kuka yi rajista, da kuma jin daɗin sake dawo da fa'idodi. Wannan kyakkyawar dama ce inda zaku iya kaiwa ga kasuwancin gida a lokacinku da dacewa.
Embassadordetails.texttwo:
** Biyan kuɗi mai gasa: ** Sami $ 50 ga kowane kasuwancin da kuka yi rajista.
- ** Rage fa'idodi: ** Karɓi $ 20 a kowace shekara Kasuwancin Rayayyun kasuwancin.
- ** sassauƙa: ** Aiki akan jadawalin kanku da kuma sarrafa kanku.
- ** Babu gwaninta da ake buƙata: ** Tallace-tallace ko ƙwarewar daukar ma'aikata ta ƙari ne, amma ba a buƙata ba.
Embassadordetails.textthree:
- ** Bayyana da kuma tuntuɓar kasuwancin da za a iya hulɗa: ** Ku shiga da Sayi Sannu.
- ** Bayyana fa'idodin membobin: ** Ka gabatar da fa'idodin membobinmu ga masu kasuwancinmu da masu yanke hukunci.
- ** Ku sanya hannu kan kasuwanci: ** Kammala aikin rajista don sabon mambobin kasuwanci.
- ** wakiltar alamar mu: ** Sanya rigunanmu mai alama a yayin ayyukan daukar ma'aikata (karfafa gwiwa amma ba wajan inganta hotonmu ba.
Embassadordetails.textfour: Idan kun yi farin ciki game da wannan damar kuma kuna son kasancewa tare da mu a matsayin jakadan waka, bi waɗannan matakan masu sauƙi don amfani:
Embassadordetails.textsix: - Bayar da cikakken suna, adireshi, lambar waya, imel, da lambar tsaro na zamantakewa (don dalilai na haraji).
Embassadordetails.texteight: - Amincewa da yarjejeniyar ku don sanya rigar da kamfanin ke yi yayin ayyukan daukar ma'aikata ta hanyar duba akwatin da ya dace.
Embassadordetails.textten:
- Sanya fam ɗin da aka kammala.
- Sanya Yarjejeniyar Yarjejeniyar Yarjejeniyar Yarjejeniyar.
- (na zaɓi) saukar da hoto kwanan nan don dalilai na asali.
Embassadordetails.texteleven:
- Duba duk bayanan da aka bayar.
- Matsa "ƙaddamar da aikace-aikacen" don kammala ƙaddamarku.

HangoutDetaile.text: Faɗa mana kaɗan game da hangen nesa, kuma za mu kula da sauran.
HangoutDetaile.textone: Na gode da gabatar mana zuwa tabo na rataye! Zamuyi amfani da komai. Idan sun zama babban jami'in Hangout, za mu aiko muku da kyauta ta musamman daga kantin sayar da kayan adon mu don nuna godiyarmu.

HelloAmbassador.text: Sha'awar a cikin shahararrun gug? Zama jakadan waka.
HelloAmbassador.textone: Muna buƙatar taimakonku don sanya dubuntar ɗakunan kasuwanci masu sha'awar shiga cikin abin da ke cikin motsi da ke haifar da abubuwan tunawa - ba kawai ma'amaloli ba ne. Za ku sami $ 50 ga kowane kasuwancin da kuka yi rajista, tare da fa'idodi mai lilo. Kawai isa zuwa kasuwancinku na gida kuma ya fara yau!

BusCongratulation.text: Kasuwancin ku shine mataki daya nesa da zama jami'ai Hangout na cewa NUNA SOWAR! Kuna da dama na musamman don samar da abubuwa fiye da kawai kayan aiki da sabis - zaku taimaka sauƙaƙe dangantakar ɗan adam na gaske kuma ƙirƙirar tunanin da na ƙarshe. Kudin shine $ 250 a kowace shekara.
BusCongratulation.textone: • Bayanan labarai guda biyu a wata:
BusCongratulation.texttwo: Inganta abubuwan da suka faru, ragi, takardun shaida, ko sanarwa akan abin da ke faruwa.

BusinesPhoto.textthree: Barka da zuwa Saya Sannu, app din da yasa mutum Haɗin kai mai dadi! Gano abubuwan da suka faru na gida, hangula, kuma mafi ta hanyar fasaha ta zamani da gasa mai kayatarwa. Mun samar da yanayin matsin lamba kyauta don taimaka muku faɗi waɗancan kalmomin sihirin. Taya murna ga shiga! Yanzu, kunna-lokaci ya yi da za a fara haɗawa!

BusinessIntro.textone: Kasuwancin ku shine mataki daya nesa da zama wani jami'ai Hangout a cikin cewa Sannu Sannu! Kuna da damar musamman don samar da abubuwa fiye da kawai da sabis - zaku taimaka wajan haɓaka haɗin gwiwar ɗan adam na ainihi da kuma tunanin tunawa.
BusinessIntro.textthree: Idan ka karɓi lamba don bayanin martabarku na pre-yarda, don Allah shigar da shi anan don tabbatar da bayanan ku.
BusinessIntro.texttwo: Idan baku karɓi lambar ku ba, ku cika fom ɗinku don tabbatarwa. Barka da zuwa Sannu Sannu Al'amari!

InfluncerIntro.text: Barka da zuwa, ka ce Sannu Tasirin!
InfluncerIntro.textone: Muna kiran ka ka zama wani bangare na wani abu mai ban sha'awa da tasiri-da yakan motsi! Mun yi imanin muryar ku da dandamali na iya taimaka mana mu haɗa kasuwancin da mutane a wata hanyar da ta wuce ma'amaloli don gina ainihin, data kasance.
InfluncerIntro.texttwo: Me ke ciki a gare ku?
InfluncerIntro.textthree:
A matsayinka na ce hello mai tasiri, zaku taimaka wajen tsara kasuwancin da ke gabatar da kasuwancin ga dandamali da kuma daukar bakasasshen jakadu don shiga motsi. Ga abin da zaku iya tsammanin:
Sami $ 100 ga kowane kasuwancin da ya zama mai faɗi sannu cikin memba na ta hanyar kai.
• Samun albashi mai gudana: Karɓi $ 50 a shekara don kowace kasuwancin da ke sabunta kuɗin shiga.
• Ambassador na magana da kari: Sami 10% daga abin da kowane jakadan ya samu lokacin da suka yi rajista ta amfani da lambar ka. Da zarar sun yi nasara, da ƙarin abin da kuka samu!
InfluncerIntro.textfour:
Ka ce sannu ya fi kawai dandamali - wata motsi ne da nufin samar da ingantaccen haɗin haɗin haɗin kai tsakanin mutane da kasuwanci. Mun mayar da hankali ga ainihin dangantaka, kuma muna buƙatar tasirin ku don taimaka mana girma.

Aikinku:
• Nuna kasuwancin da jakadun darajar haduwa da sannu.
• Shuka cibiyar sadarwarka & albashi: Yayin da tasirinka ya fadada, don haka kudin shiga. Muna da karfin gwiwa zai zama mai fashewa. Barka da nisantajan!
